# vendor

Put local external dependencies here when running exports.

Expected layout:

```text
vendor/FFDec/ffdec.jar
vendor/HFWorkshop/HFWorkshop.exe
vendor/projector/SA.exe
vendor/playerGlobal/playerglobal.swc
vendor/original_game/HFE v1.0.2.exe
vendor/original_game/HF-EX V 0.2.5.exe   (texture source for part swaps)
```

These files are intentionally ignored and should not be committed.
